notes: The single *the* of *the plague of leprosy* is given to the article on צָּרַעַת, fronted because the rectum is rendered anarthrously (rule 29).
*so* is added: the apodosis has no conjunction morpheme in it at all, the כַּאֲשֶׁר pair having already taken *as* (rule 14).
The first infinitive's לְ takes the complementizer *that* (rule 52); the coordinated second לְ has no English word written and is unrepresented.
